retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, textured American flag draped over a human figure, featuring a translucent overlay effect and bold, underlined sans-serif typography in the upper right.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a close-up, high-texture American flag with visible fabric weave. The flag is semi-transparent, revealing a human hand or face pressed against it from behind. The color palette is muted and desaturated. A bold, blocky title sits in the top right corner, underlined by a thick red bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Translucent flag fabric layered over a human silhouette
Diagonal folds in the fabric creating depth and shadow
Top-right justified display text balanced by bottom-right advisory label
Muted red and blue tones contrasting with stark white stars
coreInvariants: Visible textile weave and fabric grain
Desaturated color grading with a sepia or brown undertone
Semi-transparent layering effect between subject and flag

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The flag occupies the entire frame, while the human figure is centered behind the fabric at a 1:1 scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The human hand visible through the blue field of stars.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central hand, move to the top-right title, and follow the diagonal folds down to the bottom-right label.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with texture and fabric.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated navy blue and muted off-white stars.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows and dark brown tones from the figure behind.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted crimson red in the stripes and the title underline.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across all channels with high contrast in the shadows of the fabric folds.
paletteRestrictions: No neon or vibrant primary colors
No pure white; use cream or light grey

characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' lacks a horizontal crossbar, appearing as an inverted 'V'
The letter 'E' has shortened middle bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with a thick horizontal graphic bar for emphasis.
graphicDevices: Rectangular advisory box in the bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, wide, industrial feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary geometric structure and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph of a weathered American flag with a visible linen texture. Use a double-exposure or translucent effect to show a person's hand and face pressed against the fabric from behind. Apply a desaturated, moody color grade with deep shadows in the folds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, extended sans-serif title in the top right corner in off-white. Place a thick red horizontal bar directly underneath the text. Add a standard parental advisory label in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the fabric texture clearly visible?
Is the human figure visible but obscured by the flag?
Is the title text extended and bold?
Is the color palette desaturated and somber?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the red underline bar
mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject
Ensure the text is a generic placeholder
postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'A' in the title is stylized without a crossbar.
Verify the red underline is perfectly horizontal and matches the text width.
Ensure the flag's stars are slightly distorted by the fabric folds.
Confirm the overall image has a square 1:1 aspect ratio.
recipe.reuseFormula: Translucent [Subject] + Weathered [Textile/Flag] Overlay + Extended Bold Sans-Serif + Underline Bar
